approval: Conditional written approval after Gate 3-A.1 acceptance: 100 real model cells; TOTAL hard cap $3.00; per-model cap $1.50; PROVISIONAL gold; not an independent human-adjudicated validation.

budget.enforcement: pre-call BudgetGuard on every model call + a global total-cap check before every send; resume accumulates prior spend
budget.multi_turn_note: 100 CELLS, not 100 single API calls: the 3 active conditions use a real multi-turn tool session (frozen max 8 tool turns / 12 model calls per cell). The $1.13 single-turn planning figure under-counts; the wave2.1 multi-turn observed-token proxy (~$0.49 for 100 cells across both models) leaves wide headroom under the $3.00 cap, to be confirmed by the zero-cost full mock.

gold_tier: PROVISIONAL (mechanically adjudicated, single annotator; annotator2 NOT_OBTAINED, n=1). Against provisional, singly-adjudicated gold only.

sampling.response_format: json_object (final decision turn); tools on tool turns only
